value: The premier Filipino-Chinese student-led organization of the Ateneo de Manila University.
3/F Manuel V. Pangilinan Building, Ateneo de Manila University, Katipunan Avenue, Quezon City
Six departments, one community. Celadon runs the projects, culture, and formation that carry Filipino-Chinese life on campus — and recruits the students who make them happen.

Celadon has spent decades building a home for Filipino-Chinese students at the Ateneo. What that looks like in practice is concrete: cultural projects that fill the campus calendar, formation programs that turn members into leaders, and partnerships that reach well past Katipunan.

Every project on this site was run by students. Each one is staffed by a core team drawn from across the organization, supported by six departments that handle communications, culture, external relations, finance, people, and strategy.
Six departments keep Celadon running. Each recruits into its own pool of roles, and each has its own Ayi.
Summits, festivals, sales, and celebrations — the work Celadon puts into the world each year.
Every role is documented before applications open, so you can read exactly what the work involves before you commit to it.
Read through the roles, find the department that fits, and apply when the forms open.
